mapper.sql: select lead_id, display_name, phone, phone_hash, unionid, app_user_id, visitor_id, minor, stage, grade, score, owner_user_id, first_source, first_channel, first_content, first_touch_time, last_source, last_channel, last_touch_time, touch_count, merged_into, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, rule_grade, cast(score_reasons as text) as score_reasons, scored_time, grade_override, override_reason, override_by, override_time, next_follow_time, last_follow_time, stage_time, lost_reason, (select u.nick_name from sys_user u where u.user_id = abr_lead.owner_user_id) as owner_name, (select cast(v.profile -> 'target_countries' as text) from abr_visitor v where v.visitor_id = abr_lead.visitor_id) as target_countries from abr_lead
mapper.insert: insert into abr_lead (display_name, phone, phone_hash, unionid, app_user_id, visitor_id, minor, stage, first_source, first_channel, first_content, first_touch_time, last_source, last_channel, last_touch_time, touch_count, create_by, create_time) values (coalesce(#{displayName}, ''), #{phone}, #{phoneHash}, #{unionid}, #{appUserId}, #{visitorId}, coalesce(#{minor}, 'N'), 'new', #{firstSource}, coalesce(#{firstChannel}, ''), coalesce(#{firstContent}, ''), #{firstTouchTime}, #{firstSource}, coalesce(#{firstChannel}, ''), #{firstTouchTime}, 0, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update abr_lead set display_name = case when coalesce(display_name, '') = '' then coalesce(#{displayName}, '') else display_name end, phone = coalesce(phone, #{phone}), phone_hash = coalesce(phone_hash, #{phoneHash}), unionid = coalesce(unionid, #{unionid}), app_user_id = coalesce(app_user_id, #{appUserId}), visitor_id = coalesce(visitor_id, #{visitorId}), minor = case when #{minor} = 'Y' then 'Y' else minor end, update_time = now() where lead_id = #{leadId}

update abr_lead set first_source = case when #{time} < first_touch_time then #{source} else first_source end, first_channel = case when #{time} < first_touch_time then coalesce(#{channel}, '') else first_channel end, first_content = case when #{time} < first_touch_time then coalesce(#{content}, '') else first_content end, first_touch_time = least(first_touch_time, #{time}), last_source = case when #{time} >= last_touch_time then #{source} else last_source end, last_channel = case when #{time} >= last_touch_time and coalesce(#{channel}, '') <> '' then #{channel} else last_channel end, last_touch_time = greatest(last_touch_time, #{time}), touch_count = touch_count + #{count}, update_time = now() where lead_id = #{leadId}
update abr_lead set merged_into = #{intoId}, update_by = 'system', update_time = now() where lead_id = #{leadId} and merged_into is null
mapper.insert: insert into abr_lead_touch (lead_id, source, touch_type, channel_code, content_code, ref_type, ref_id, event_id, summary, occurred_time, create_by, create_time) values (#{leadId}, #{source}, #{touchType}, coalesce(#{channelCode}, ''), coalesce(#{contentCode}, ''), coalesce(#{refType}, ''), #{refId}, #{eventId}, coalesce(#{summary}, ''), #{occurredTime}, coalesce(#{createBy}, ''), now()) on conflict (event_id) where event_id is not null do nothing
mapper.update: update abr_lead_touch set lead_id = #{toId} where lead_id = #{fromId}
mapper.select: select * from ( select occurred_time as "time", 'touch' as "kind", touch_type as "type", source as "source", summary as "summary", channel_code as "channel", content_code as "content", ref_type as "refType", ref_id as "refId" from abr_lead_touch where lead_id = #{leadId} union all select create_time, 'event', event_type, '', '', '', '', coalesce(ref_type, ''), ref_id from abr_event where (visitor_id = #{visitorId} or app_user_id = #{appUserId}) and event_type not in ('app_user_registered', 'app_user_phone_bound', 'plan_moment', 'plan_share_created') union all select create_time, 'follow', follow_kind, method, content, '', '', 'follow', follow_id from abr_lead_follow where lead_id = #{leadId} union all select create_time, 'tool', tool, '', '', coalesce(channel_code, ''), coalesce(content_code, ''), 'tool_run', tool_run_id from abr_tool_run where visitor_id = #{visitorId} union all select create_time, 'assessment', assessment_status, '', '', coalesce(channel_code, ''), coalesce(content_code, ''), 'assessment', assessment_id from abr_assessment where visitor_id = #{visitorId} ) t order by "time" desc limit #{limit}
select profile ->> 'age_band' from abr_visitor where visitor_id = #{visitorId}

select (select string_agg(distinct coalesce(payload ->> 'moment', dedup_key), ',') from abr_event where event_type = 'plan_moment' and (visitor_id = #{visitorId} or app_user_id = #{appUserId})) as "moments", (select profile ->> 'intake_year' from abr_visitor where visitor_id = #{visitorId}) as "intakeYear", (select months_to_intake from abr_profile where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and months_to_intake is not null order by profile_id desc limit 1) as "monthsToIntake", (select count(*) from abr_assessment where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and assessment_status = 'submitted') as "submitted", (select count(*) from abr_tool_run where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and create_time >= #{since}) as "toolRuns", (select count(*) from abr_plan_item where visitor_id = #{visitorId}) as "planItems", (select count(*) from abr_share where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and kind = 'plan_view') as "shares", (select coalesce(sum(view_count), 0) from abr_share where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and kind = 'plan_view') as "shareViews", (select string_agg(distinct source, ',') from (select first_source as source from abr_lead where lead_id = #{leadId} union select source from abr_lead_touch where lead_id = #{leadId}) s) as "sources"
mapper.update: update abr_lead set score = #{score}, rule_grade = #{ruleGrade}, score_reasons = cast(#{reasons} as jsonb), scored_time = now(), grade = case when grade_override = 'Y' then grade else #{ruleGrade} end where lead_id = #{leadId}

update abr_lead set grade = #{grade}, grade_override = 'Y', override_reason = #{reason}, override_by = #{operator}, override_time = now(), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where lead_id = #{leadId}

update abr_lead set grade = rule_grade, grade_override = 'N', override_reason = '', override_by = #{operator}, override_time = now(), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where lead_id = #{leadId}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_lead_score_log (lead_id, from_grade, to_grade, score, rule_grade, change_type, reason, operator, create_time) values (#{leadId}, #{fromGrade}, #{toGrade}, #{score}, #{ruleGrade}, #{changeType}, coalesce(#{reason}, ''), #{operator}, now())
mapper.select: select log_id as "logId", from_grade as "fromGrade", to_grade as "toGrade", score as "score", rule_grade as "ruleGrade", change_type as "changeType", reason as "reason", operator as "operator", to_char(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "time" from abr_lead_score_log where lead_id = #{leadId} order by log_id desc limit 200
select lead_id from abr_lead where merged_into is null and del_flag = '0' and stage not in ('won', 'lost') order by lead_id
select lead_id from abr_lead where merged_into is null and del_flag = '0' and (visitor_id = #{visitorId} or app_user_id = #{appUserId}) order by lead_id limit 1
mapper.update: update abr_lead set display_name = coalesce(#{displayName}, ''), remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where lead_id = #{leadId}

update abr_lead set last_follow_time = now(), next_follow_time = #{nextFollowTime}, stage = case when stage = 'new' then 'contacted' else stage end, stage_time = case when stage = 'new' then now() else stage_time end, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where lead_id = #{leadId}

update abr_lead set stage = #{stage}, stage_time = now(), lost_reason = #{lostReason}, next_follow_time = case when #{stage} in ('won', 'lost') then null else next_follow_time end, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where lead_id = #{leadId}
update abr_lead set owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where lead_id = #{leadId}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_lead_follow (lead_id, follow_kind, method, content, next_follow_time, stage_from, stage_to, owner_from, owner_to, create_by, create_time) values (#{leadId}, #{followKind}, coalesce(#{method}, ''), coalesce(#{content}, ''), #{nextFollowTime}, #{stageFrom}, #{stageTo}, #{ownerFrom}, #{ownerTo}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.select: select follow_id as followId, lead_id as leadId, follow_kind as followKind, method, content, next_follow_time as nextFollowTime, stage_from as stageFrom, stage_to as stageTo, owner_from as ownerFrom, owner_to as ownerTo, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime from abr_lead_follow where lead_id = #{leadId} order by follow_id desc limit 500
select count(*) from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
